exercise.name: Lever Seated Hip Adduction

reference.title: Lever Seated Hip Adduction
reference.listing: Video (movement reference only; the page could not be fetched from the authoring environment (gymvisual.com refused the request), so the data sheet was not read and the movement follows the exercise name and standard coaching)

equipment: Seated hip adduction machine (two lever arms on vertical axles, pads inside the knees)

breathing.pattern: Breathe out as the knees come together, breathe in as they open.
breathing.cadence: About 1.2 s in, short squeeze, about 2.3 s out

prescription.effort: Stop 1-3 reps short of failure (RIR 1-3, clinical opinion)
prescription.load: Stack load is user-chosen: close fully without rocking the trunk.
prescription.progression: Add reps, then load; slower lowering

cues.text: Sit with the back on the pad, knees bent about 90 degrees and the pads against the insides of the knees, legs open; hold the side handles.
Breathe out and squeeze the knees together, moving the pads in on their arcs.
Hold with the knees nearly together.
Breathe in and let the legs open slowly to the start.
Pause open, feeling the inner thighs stretch, without letting the stack rest.

mistakes.fix: Set the start so the stretch is mild.
Keep the back on the pad; lighten the stack.
Keep the feet on the footrests.

kinematics.norm: From about 35 degrees each side to nearly together (clinical opinion)
Seated with the hips and knees at about 90 degrees (clinical opinion)
Each pad turns about a vertical axle under the hip joint, so it does not slide on the knee (clinical opinion)
Adductor group working hardest near the closed position (illustrative, clinical opinion)
About 1.2 s in and 2.3 s out (clinical opinion)

sources.title: GymVisual #4241, Lever Seated Hip Adduction, video (movement reference)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, numbness or tingling occurs.
Stack load is user-chosen: start light; the open position stretches the groin.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
modify: Groin discomfort: start with the legs less open.
progressions: Longer hold with the knees together.

muscleNotes.adductors_r: Prime movers: draw the thighs together.
muscleNotes.adductors_l: Prime movers: draw the thighs together.
muscleNotes.core: Keeps the trunk on the pad.

guides.label: Knee in on an arc about the hip
